description: This PHP file contains the implementation of the ADOdb PostgreSQL 7 driver, including the main driver class ADODB_postgres7, methods for schema and metadata retrieval, connection handling, and specific recordset classes for PostgreSQL 7 support.

classes.name: ADODB_postgres7
classes.description: Main class implementing PostgreSQL 7 driver extending ADODB_postgres64 with features for schema queries, limit handling, and client charset management.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_postgres7
classes.description: Recordset class for handling query results with cursor navigation, optimized for PostgreSQL 7.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_assoc_postgres7
classes.description: Recordset class with associative array fetching capability, extending PostgreSQL 7 recordset handling.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Constructs SQL with LIMIT and OFFSET for row limiting in PostgreSQL 7.

methods.name: _generateMetaColumnsSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to fetch table column metadata.

methods.name: metaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a specified table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes parameterized or static SQL queries using native pg_query functions.

methods.name: getCharSet
methods.description: Retrieves the current client charset encoding.
